tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and manifest to understand the crate's purpose, feature flags, provider support, and example layout.

tour.title: Public SDK Surface
tour.description: Inspect the crate root and core modules that expose provider-neutral messages, requests, model traits, stream events, errors, and tool definitions.

tour.title: Provider Adapters
tour.description: Compare the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini provider modules to see how each client maps provider-specific payloads into shared SDK types.

tour.title: Tool-Aware Runtime
tour.description: Follow the runtime modules that run model turns, accumulate stream state, register tools, and continue model-tool-model loops.

tour.title: Message Stream Adapter
tour.description: Review the optional message-stream feature and chatbot examples to understand how SDK events become an AI SDK UI-compatible SSE protocol.

tour.title: Provider Examples
tour.description: Use the standalone examples to see minimal generation, streaming, and tool-calling flows for each supported provider.
